name: logo-wall-quote
purpose: The customers band: a section title over a framed logo wall of linked client marks with one signed quote in its aside, closed by a call to action. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'logo-wall-quote', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `logo-wall`, `quote` and `button`.
useWhen: To prove adoption with marks and let one customer speak, early on a home or solution page.
avoidWhen: For several quotes in turn → use `client-quotes`.
For marks with photos and stories in a mosaic → use `client-mosaic`.
related: logo-wall` — the wall the marks are laid in, with the quote in its aside.
logo` — draws every mark (the wall's and the quote's) right on both themes.
bestPractices: Eight or nine logos fill the rectangle wall beside the aside.

Pass client registry entries (`@aziontech/webkit/assets/client-registry`) as they stand: each carries `name`, `logo` and either `logoLight` (a light-theme drawing) or `artwork` (which theme a single file must be inverted on), and every mark renders through `Logo`.

Without a registry entry, set `logoTreatment` per mark: `monochrome` for a mark drawn in one ink that must follow the theme, `invert-light` for a reversed mark that must flip on the light theme, `as-is` for a colour mark; give a `logoLight` file instead when the light theme needs a different drawing.
Give the quote's company mark a `logoLight` (or an `artwork`) the same way, so it stays legible on both themes.
Keep to one or two actions under the quote: the primary (`secondary` kind) and an optional outlined `secondaryAction`.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Layout of the band: `wall` sets the client marks with the quote in their aside, `quote` sets the quote alone as a full-width band (the design sample's QuoteBand) and needs no logos.

props.name: quoteKind
props.doc: Register of the quote in the `quote` layout: the featured `highlight` or the band-sized `signed` sentence.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the logo wall.

props.name: logos
props.doc: The client marks, in order; each is `{ name, logo, logoLight?, logoTreatment?, artwork?, href? }` where `logoTreatment` is `'as-is'`, `'monochrome'` or `'invert-light'` and `artwork` is the registry's `'color'`, `'light'` or `'dark'`.

props.name: quote
props.doc: The signed quote in the wall's aside; `{ text, name, jobTitle, logo, logoAlt, logoLight?, artwork? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Button under the quote; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Outlined button beside the primary one under the quote; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { CLIENTS } from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/client-registry'
  import LogoWallQuote from '@aziontech/webkit/logo-wall-quote'

  const WALL = [
    'Agibank',
    'iFood',
    'Itaú',
    'GPA',
    'Netshoes',
    'Renner',
    'Magalu',
    'Dafiti',
    'Prime Video'
  ]

  const logos = WALL.map((name) => CLIENTS.find((client) => client.name === name))

  const zoop = CLIENTS.find((client) => client.name === 'Zoop')
</script>

<template>
  <LogoWallQuote
    eyebrow="Customers"
    title="Trusted by the largest retailers and banks"
    aria-label="Retailers and banks running on Azion"
    :logos="logos"
    :quote="{
      text: 'Azion delivered the advanced protection and superior performance we needed, with fast implementation and immediate results.',
      name: 'Ismael Aguilar',
      jobTitle: 'Information Security Manager at Zoop',
      logo: zoop.logo,
      logoLight: zoop.logoLight,
      artwork: zoop.artwork,
      logoAlt: zoop.name
    }"
    :primary-action="{
      label: 'Read the case study',
      href: 'https://example.com/stories',
      trailing: true
    }"
    :secondary-action="{ label: 'See all customers', href: 'https://example.com/customers' }"
  />
</template>
